items.title: Software Engineer, Tokens and Prompt Structures
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role: The Encodings Infra team maintains the libraries that engineers and researchers across Anthropic use to encode text and multimodal data into a form that Claude can consume. It also determines Claude’s prompt shape: how a user’s turn is represented to the model, how Claude calls tools and receives tool results, and so on. As a Software Engineer on this team, you'll own the design and maintenance of these libraries—keeping their APIs intuitive, their performance sharp, and their abstractions solid enough that most of the org never has to think about encodings or prompt structures at all. You’ll have the satisfaction of knowing that your work enabled Claude to learn new ways of understanding the world. This role is unusually broad: your work will touch systems across the codebase, from pretraining to finetuning to the API, and you'll collaborate closely with both researchers and engineers to make sure new encoding ideas can move quickly from experiment to production. Responsibilities: Maintain and improve the encoding libraries used by engineers and researchers across Anthropic Run experiments to determine the optimal way to feed structured data into Claude without confusing it Design data structures and abstractions that shield most of the organization from the details of how encoded data works while enabling “power users” Adapt the encoding libraries to support new research directions as they emerge, and make sure that we can ship these research ideas to production Optimize encoding performance across the systems that depend on these libraries You may be a good fit if you: Have 5+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time spent maintaining libraries, SDKs, or developer-facing APIs Have familiarity with ML terminology and LLM architecture — you don't need to be an ML expert, but enough understanding to work effectively alongside researchers and understand the results of experiments Have experience carrying out complex refactors in large codebases Have strong communication skills and enjoy working closely with researchers and engineers to understand what they need Are results-oriented, with a bias towards flexibility and impact Pick up slack, even if it goes outside your job description Care about the societal impacts of your work Strong candidates may also have experience with: Tokenizers or other text/data encoding systems Maintaining a widely-used library over a long period of time Performance optimization Python and/or Rust Reinforcement learning or model training infrastructure Representative projects: Working with a research team to ship a new multimodal data type (audio, video, etc) to production Redesigning a core abstraction so that we can change how data is encoded into Claude without breaking downstream teams The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $405,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Product Owner
items.description: About us EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. About the role We are looking for a Product Owner to take ownership of the Players domain within our GamMatrix platform — the systems that govern how a player is registered, authenticated, consented, classified and protected across every operator on our platform. This is a backend platform product role, not a front-end or marketing role. The person in this seat owns functionality that is regulatory-critical and consumed by dozens of operators and internal products (MoneyMatrix, DataMatrix, CasinoEngine, PIMS). Requirements must be precise, edge cases must be thought through, and compliance implications must be understood before development starts. You will work inside an established delivery structure: a quarterly commitment cycle and two-week sprints, alongside a Tech Lead, developers and QAs, with Product Management, PMO, Integration Management and Account Management as your main stakeholders. What You'll get to do: Product and requirements ownership Own the vision, backlog and prioritisation for the Players domain, and be accountable for the business value delivered by the team. Translate business and regulatory requests into structured requirements: BRDs, user flows, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation clear enough that the team can build without ambiguity. Run discovery and business analysis continuously — with operators, Account Management, Compliance and dependent product teams — rather than as a one-off phase. Understand and document ownership boundaries and integration dependencies between the Players domain and Wallets, KYC/AML, payments, reporting and game management. Quarterly (macro) cycle T-shirting: review and size incoming work within the 10-business-day SLA, clarifying gaps and coordinating with technical stakeholders. Q Planning: bring only viable, unblocked, functionally understood and sized items forward; assess likely spillover from the current quarter; confirm the final quarterly commitment. Q Start: convert each committed item into a properly configured, traceable local EPIC (linked planning item, correct fix version, labels, preserved sizing) and set up the backlog and dashboards for tracking. Q Review: give an accurate, unvarnished view of progress at the midpoint, flag risks and dependencies early, and propose scope adjustments that protect the highest-value outcomes. Q Big Demo: represent the team company-wide — prepare and present what was delivered, why it matters commercially, and the metrics that support it. Sprint (micro) cycle Bring a prioritized, Definition-of-Ready-compliant list of work into Sprint Planning: requirements validated with the team, no blockers, dependencies resolved, dev and QA estimates in place. Prepare and lead refinement sessions (typically twice per sprint) and maintain a rolling buffer of at least two sprints of refined, ready work. Stay close to delivery in daily standups, unblock and clarify quickly, and take deep discussions offline. Support release readiness, validation and post-release verification and participate in production investigations and incident follow-ups for the domain. Scope and stakeholder management Handle stakeholder communication directly, including operator-facing and cross-BU discussions. Manage in-quarter scope changes by offsetting new work against existing commitments of similar effort, keeping capacity balanced and delivery stable. Escalate blockers with proposed options and trade-offs, not just problems. What we’re looking for: Required 3+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager or senior Business Analyst on backend, API-driven or platform products. Demonstrable experience writing requirements for systems where correctness, auditability and edge-case handling matter — authentication, identity, payments, compliance, or similar. Fluency with Agile delivery in practice: backlog management, Definition of Ready, refinement, estimation, sprint and release mechanics. Strong working knowledge of Jira and Confluence, including structuring EPICs, versions, labels and dashboards. Ability to read and reason about API documentation and system integration flows, and to hold a credible technical conversation with a Tech Lead without needing to code. Clear, structured written English — a large part of this role is producing documentation that other teams depend on. Comfort operating with multiple stakeholders and conflicting priorities, and the judgment to say no with a reason. Strongly preferred iGaming experience, particularly in player account management (PAM), responsible gaming, KYC/AML or regulatory reporting. Familiarity with regulated-market requirements across multiple jurisdictions. Exposure to authentication standards (OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, SSO) and consent management. Experience supporting release processes and production incident handling. Here's what we offer: Start with 22 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 32 days by your fifth year with us. Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required. Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance. Private Medical Subscription. Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and LinkedIn Learning, and a budget for external training. Access to an Employee Assistance Program through TELUS Health. Our office perks include parking, on-site massages, and frequent team-building activities in various locations. And did we mention our amazing office space complete with its own pool and gym? At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association. In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification. EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions.

items.title: VP, Global Developer Relations
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As our VP of Global Developer Relations, you’ll be the voice and facilitator of Mistral to the developer, scientific, and technical communities. You’ll build and scale a global DevRel strategy that fosters deep engagement, advocacy, and love for Mistral’s models and technology. Your team will build communities and educate, excite, and empower developers to adopt, innovate, and evangelize Mistral’s technology—whether they’re startups, enterprises, researchers, or open-source contributors. You’ll work closely with Product, Research, Engineering, Marketing, Communications, and more to ensure developers have the tools, resources, and inspiration they need to succeed with Mistral. What You Will Do Build a Global Developer Movement - Develop and execute a global DevRel strategy that connects Mistral and our AI platform effectively with developers, scientists, and technologists. - Create authentic, developer-first engagement—focusing on education, inspiration, and community, with great content and AI tools. - Foster a culture of advocacy where developers naturally champion Mistral in their networks, projects, and conversations. Engage and Inspire the Technical Community - Lead high-impact developer engagement initiatives, including: - Technical content (e.g., tutorials, blog posts, videos, documentation) that helps developers get started, optimize, and innovate with Mistral’s models. - Community programs (e.g., hackathons, meetups, AMAs, Discord/Slack communities) that bring together AI builders, researchers, and enthusiasts. - Evangelism & thought leadership (e.g., conference talks, podcasts, technical deep dives) that showcase Mistral’s unique value and capabilities. - Work with Product and Research teams to translate complex AI innovations into accessible, exciting, and actionable insights for developers. Enable Developer Success, particularly for self-service adoption - Build scalable enablement programs (e.g., onboarding guides, SDKs, APIs, sample projects) that reduce friction for developers adopting Mistral’s models. - Create feedback loops between the developer community and Mistral’s Product/Engineering teams to shape the roadmap based on real-world needs. Scale a World-Class DevRel Team - Hire, mentor, and lead a global team of Developer Advocates, Engineers and Evangelists - with particular strength in Europe and San Francisco - Define metrics and KPIs to measure the impact of DevRel (e.g., developer adoption, community growth, engagement, advocacy). - Lead from the front as a fantastic representative of Mistral at events, in social, and in project communities Drive Open Source & Ecosystem Growth - Champion open-source contributions and collaborative innovation around Mistral’s models. - Partner with startups, enterprises, and academic institutions to accelerate adoption and co-innovation. - Identify and nurture key developer influencers, maintainers, and ambassadors who can amplify Mistral’s reach and impact. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Proven leadership in Developer Relations, Developer Marketing, or Technical Evangelism for a B2B technology company, preferably in AI, cloud, and open-source. - Deep technical credibility—ability to engage with developers, scientists, and engineers on their terms (e.g., code, research, architecture). - Passion for community building—a track record of growing and nurturing technical communities (e.g., open-source projects, developer forums, hackathons). - Strong storytelling and communication skills—ability to simplify complex concepts and inspire developers through content, talks, and interactions. - Strategic and operational excellence—ability to scale DevRel globally while maintaining a hands-on, authentic approach. - Collaborative mindset—ability to work across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales to align DevRel with Mistral’s broader goals. Bonus Points If You Have - Experience in AI, machine learning, or large language models (LLMs). - Personally contributed meaningfully to open source projects and communities. - Led global DevRel teams in high-growth, competitive markets. - Personal brand or following in the developer or AI community Experience launching and scaling developer-focused products or tools. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. About the Role Fireblocks is expanding its security organization to meet the risks and opportunities created by the rapid adoption of AI — both inside the company and across our platform. This is a hands-on, builder-focused role. Assess the configuration and security posture of AI systems and tools in use, and identify and prioritize gaps. AI Security Architecture & Tooling Design and propose new tooling, configurations, and projects that reduce AI-related risk. Architect and implement the resulting solutions end-to-end, partnering with engineering teams where needed. Build and operate the AI security infrastructure that makes AI usage across Fireblocks secure by default. Deploy open-weight models to support the incident response teams in investigating and responding to security incidents in real time. A genuine builder mentality — a track record of designing, shipping, and operating security tooling or infrastructure end-to-end, not just advising on it. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently while coordinating closely with Security, R&D, and other stakeholders. items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? Adoption of AI is moving rapidly from pilots to production. Enterprises across APAC are investing in generative-AI programs, creating a once-in-a-decade market inflection point. At Cohere, we’re committed to transforming the Japan enterprise landscape through strategic partnerships and innovative AI solutions. As a Partner Development Manager for the Japan Enterprise Market, you’ll be at the heart of our mission to empower businesses across the region with cutting-edge AI technologies. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic, cross-cultural environment and is passionate about driving growth through collaboration. You’ll work closely with leading enterprises, system integrators, and technology partners to co-create value, expand market reach, and deliver impactful AI solutions tailored to the unique needs of Japanese businesses. Japan is a key strategic market for Cohere, and your work will directly contribute to our success in this region. You’ll have the opportunity to shape partnerships that drive digital transformation, foster innovation, and position Cohere as a leader in the Japan AI ecosystem. If you’re a strategic thinker, a relationship builder, and eager to make a meaningful impact in one of the world’s most dynamic markets, this role is your chance to shape the future of AI in Japan. As our Partner Development Manager - Japan, you will own the success of our partner relationships in Japan. Key responsibilities include: Partner Strategy & Execution - Define and execute Cohere’s partner-go-to-market plan for the Japan Enterprise Market, aligning with regional business objectives. - Partner with the broader GTM team to identify and recruit high-impact partners across system integrators, distributors, resellers, ISVs, and cloud providers. - Develop relationships with key stakeholders across the partner ecosystem to ensure success of the partnership. items.title: Applied AI Architect, Partner
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams. Within the team, Partner Applied AI Architects work with strategic partners—including global and regional system integrators, consulting and advisory firms, and technology partners—to extend OpenAI’s technical reach and help partners deliver high-quality AI solutions for our joint customers. We bring together technical strategy, partner enablement, architecture expertise, and practical deployment experience, working closely with Partnerships, Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, and specialist delivery teams. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Partner Applied AI Architect, you will be a senior technical advisor to a portfolio of strategic partners and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership and delivery organizations. You will shape how partners build practices around OpenAI, develop solutions using our products, and take joint customers from AI opportunity and technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact. You will own the technical strategy and architecture across partner engagements involving ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In close partnership with the Revenue Partnerships team, you will translate joint business priorities into technical strategies, solution patterns, enablement plans, and a focused portfolio of high-value customer opportunities. You will work directly with partners on strategic customer engagements—leading discovery, shaping architectures, navigating complex technical decisions, and helping secure technical wins—while building the partner capabilities required to deliver successfully and independently at scale. You will remain accountable for the technical quality and outcomes of the partnership while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, security, product, enablement, and other teams when deeper expertise is needed. The role calls for strong architectural judgment, executive presence, partner leadership, and the ability to move confidently between business strategy and hands-on technical conversations. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a portfolio of strategic partners, building trusted relationships with their executives, AI leaders, architects, engineering teams, and delivery organizations. - Partner closely with the Revenue Partnerships team as one virtual team, aligning partner strategy, technical priorities, joint customer opportunities, and measures of success. - Develop the technical strategy and plan for each partner, identifying priority solutions, use cases, technical capabilities, enablement needs, delivery risks, and opportunities to drive customer adoption. - Assess prospective and existing partners’ technical capabilities and delivery readiness, identifying strengths, gaps, and the investments required to successfully deliver OpenAI-powered solutions. - Lead technical discovery with partners and joint customers to identify, qualify, and prioritize AI use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes. - Develop clear Applied AI architectures spanning models, applications, enterprise data, integrations, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, reliability, and deployment. - Collaborate with partner sales and technical teams on strategic opportunities, providing technical guidance through discovery, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, architectural recommendations, and proofs of value. - Guide partners through their initial and most strategic OpenAI deployments, helping them navigate technical tradeoffs and production dependencies while ensuring solutions meet a high bar for quality, security, reliability, and responsible deployment. - Build partner capability and technical self-sufficiency through tailored enablement, architectural guidance, reusable solution patterns, technical workshops, and mentorship. - Establish clear standards and mechanisms for partner-delivered solution quality, identifying risks early and intervening when architecture, implementation, security, evaluation, or adoption issues threaten customer outcomes. - Orchestrate the right OpenAI specialists across Deployment Engineering, Product, Security, implementation, enablement, and domain teams while maintaining clear ownership and handoffs between OpenAI and partner delivery teams. - Track partner capability, joint pipeline technical progress, production adoption, usage, solution quality, and measurable customer impact to identify where additional investment or intervention is needed. - Identify repeatable patterns across partner engagements and turn them into architectures, playbooks, reference solutions, and best practices that allow successful approaches to scale across partners and customers. - Bring insights from partners and joint customers back to Product, Engineering, Research, and Partnerships, helping shape product strategy, technical guidance, and the broader OpenAI partner ecosystem. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have significant experience in senior customer- or partner-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, partner engineering, field architecture, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical consulting. - Have worked successfully with global or regional system integrators, consulting firms, or other technology partners, and understand how partner organizations sell, architect, and deliver complex enterprise technology. - Have guided complex enterprise organizations from technical discovery and evaluation through production deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact. - Can build credibility with CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, partner executives, and AI leaders while communicating equally effectively with architects and hands-on engineers. - Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, enterprise data, integrations, identity, security, privacy, and governance. - Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLMs, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, and enterprise AI workflows. - Can prototype when useful, explain technical tradeoffs clearly, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript. - Have experience enabling technical organizations at scale, turning your own expertise into repeatable architectures, training, patterns, and practices that others can successfully apply. - Understand enterprise security and compliance requirements and can guide partners and customers through the technical considerations required to move AI systems safely into production. - Are comfortable balancing the needs of OpenAI, the partner, and the end customer, and can exercise sound judgment when those priorities do not perfectly align. - Know when to go deep personally, when to coach a partner toward the answer, and when to engage specialist resources. - Can prioritize across a portfolio of partners and customer opportunities, focusing technical resources on the work most likely to create durable customer value and adoption. - Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical architecture, executive decision, enablement plan, or path to production. - Own problems end-to-end, learn quickly, and care deeply about helping partners and customers deploy advanced AI responsibly. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE This role drives process improvement across Customer Operations, working alongside Fraud & Payments (FP), Responsible Gaming (RG), Customer Support (CS), and Anti-Money Laundering (AML). You will build a first-hand understanding of how each function operates, partner with key stakeholders to identify friction points and breakdowns, both internal and customer-facing, and prioritise high-impact fixes, starting with the gaps generating the highest volume of cross-departmental escalations. You will work with the relevant teams to redesign workflows, automate manual steps, and align on shared ways of working. Major initiatives are supported by the Ops Project Management team for tracking and delivery, with ownership shared between this role and the operational teams involved. This role also owns operational business reporting, working closely with the Director of Operational Excellence and Performance to give leadership timely, accurate performance insights. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: Process Discovery & Bottleneck Identification - Build and maintain a deep understanding of end-to-end workflows and handoffs across RFP, RG, CS, and AML. - Map cross-departmental processes to identify where handoffs break down, work stalls, or duplicate effort occurs. - Maintain a live, prioritized backlog of process issues weighted by frequency and business impact. Escalation-Led Prioritization - Track and analyze cross-departmental escalations to identify high-volume root causes. - Prioritize improvement initiatives based on internal impact and reduction of player friction (e.g., verification delays, payment holds, RG interventions). - Report escalation trends, root causes, and player-impact metrics to leadership. Process Redesign & Automation - Redesign processes end-to-end to address structural root causes. - Identify opportunities to eliminate manual effort and implement automation (workflow routing, RPA, AI-driven process improvements) in partnership with Product, Technology, and Process Improvement & Automation teams. - Build business cases for automation, establishing clear ROI, efficiency gains, and tracked hours saved. Project Delivery & Operational Readiness - Drive major process and automation initiatives from problem identification through implementation. - Partner with the Ops Project Management team for milestone tracking and delivery support while holding accountability for change outcomes. - Ensure operational readiness prior to launch, including impact assessments, training needs, and complete documentation. Cross-Functional Alignment - Act as the connective link across RFP, RG, CS, AML, Product, Technology, and Compliance. - Facilitate alignment, resolve process ownership disputes early, and foster a continuous-improvement operational culture. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: - 3+ years of experience in iGaming or a similar fast-paced tech/operational industry. - Proven track record in process mapping, root-cause analysis, and cross-departmental process redesign. - Strong background in operational reporting, data visualization, and translating performance data into strategic business insights. - Hands-on familiarity with process automation tools, AI-driven operational tools, workflow routing, or RPA technologies. - Demonstrated experience collaborating across multi-functional operational teams (e.g., Fraud, Payments, Customer Support, Compliance). - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to navigate change management smoothly. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. Exciting, on-the-job learning opportunities. 1 in 3 of our people level up their roles every year. If you deliver, you move. Competitive pay and bonus scheme Market-synced pay that respects your craft and location. Performance-based bonus recognition based on your impact (up to 20%). Help us build our crew and get paid for it with our high-value referral bonus. Because great people know great people. Other perks 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers Smooth Parental Return: Ease back into work with 12 weeks of transition support, including fully paid Fridays off during your first three months back Access to Employee Assistance Program Wednesday massages In-house baristas serve you free coffee, fresh juices and smoothies. Daily catered breakfast and regular company-wide events. Snack walls and drink fridges on every floor. Fun, modern office spaces. Pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles and an F1 simulator. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.title: Web3 研发工程师（资深）— 交易询价方向
items.description: 【岗位职责】 一、交易聚合与路由 1.负责 Web3 聚合交易系统的后端架构设计与开发，整合多条公链、多个 DEX 及做市商流动性来源。 2.设计并实现路由算法与最优路径选择策略，平衡价格、滑点、Gas、成交概率等多目标。 3.负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障高并发与网络拥堵场景下的稳定性与成功率。 二、询价与做市商接入 1.设计并实现询价（RFQ / Quote）系统，接入链上池子、链下做市商、CEX 等多类报价源。 2.负责做市商接入协议的设计与实现，覆盖报价订阅、更新、成交确认与风控校验。 3.构建报价质量评估与做市商分级机制，动态调整路由权重。 三、高并发与低延迟 1.优化询价、路由、交易链路的端到端延迟与吞吐能力。 2.设计交易风控与限流机制，覆盖滑点保护、价格偏离、重放保护、Gas 异常等场景。 【任职要求】 一、技术基础 1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。 2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。 3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。 具备低延迟、高并发系统的设计与优化经验。 4.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。 5.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Sui / Ton 者优先。 熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网交易系统的实战经验。 6.熟悉主流 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）的池子模型、价格计算与状态维护。 7.具备聚合器（如 1inch、Jupiter、OKX 等）的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过路由算法、报价聚合或交易执行链路的设计与落地。 8.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。 9.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。 二、AI 工程能力 1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。 2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。 3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。 【加分项】 1.有做市商系统、报价引擎、订单管理（OMS）相关的开发经验。 2.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、Bundle 提交（如 Flashbots、Jito）等相关经验。 3.有跨链桥、跨链交易、Intent-based 交易（CoW、UniswapX、Across 等）相关的开发经验。 4.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。 5.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

items.description: 【公司简介】 我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。 【岗位职责】 一、行情与实时数据系统 1.负责 Web3 行情系统的后端架构设计与开发，覆盖链上行情、DEX 池子数据、订单簿、成交流、K 线等多类实时数据的采集、清洗、聚合、存储与分发。 2.构建低延迟、高吞吐、可水平扩展的实时计算链路，保障行情数据在高并发场景下的稳定性、一致性与时效性。 3.设计并实现实时数据推送服务（WebSocket / gRPC Streaming 等），支撑前端、策略、交易等下游业务对实时行情的消费需求。 二、链上数据中台建设 1.负责链上数据中台的整体设计与落地，构建从节点接入、区块解析、事件解码到结构化存储的完整数据链路。 2.负责区块、交易、事件日志的解析与解码（Log Decode、Trace 解析、内部交易还原等），将原始链上数据转化为业务可消费的结构化数据。 3.抽象多链数据模型，沉淀通用的解析框架与数据资产，支撑行情、交易、钱包、预测市场等上层业务。 4.构建实时数据监控与报警机制，覆盖节点健康度、数据延迟、数据完整性、解析异常等关键指标。 【任职要求】 一、技术基础 1.5 年以上后端开发经验，语言 Java 或 Go 均可，熟悉 Java 者更佳 Java 方向：3 年以上 Java 实战经验，熟悉 JVM 调优、并发编程，掌握 Spring 生态。 Go 方向：3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。 2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。 3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。 4.具备实时计算系统的落地经验，熟悉状态管理、背压、容错、Exactly-Once 等机制；使用过 Akka 或 Pekko、Reactor（或 Project Reactor / RxJava）、Redis Stream。 5.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理（共识、P2P、Gas / 手续费模型等），熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。 6.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。 7.具备链上数据中台、行情系统或类似数据平台的项目经验，熟悉 Log Decode、ABI 解析、Trace / Internal Tx 处理等，主导过多链数据模型抽象或通用解析框架的建设。 8.主导过中大型后端系统或数据平台从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。 具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。 二、AI 工程能力 1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。 2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。 3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。 【加分项】 1.有大数据实时与离线计算经验（Flink、Spark、Storm 等），熟悉 Lambda / Kappa 架构。 2.有 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）池子状态维护、价格计算、聚合行情相关经验。 3.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、抢跑保护等相关经验。 4.有时序数据库（如 TimescaleDB、Druid、ClickHouse）在行情场景下的落地经验。 5.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。 6.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

items.title: Web3 研发工程师（资深）— 钱包方向
items.description: 【岗位职责】 一、钱包账户体系 1.负责钱包账户系统的架构设计与演进，统一管理助记词、私钥、硬件、MPC、托管（Turnkey 等）、机器人钱包、保险箱等多类账户形态。 2.主导异构账户体系的融合与抽象，沉淀统一的账户模型与 Web3 ID 能力，支撑钱包及其他业务方的接入需求。 3.设计对外可接入的钱包能力，对其他业务线开放标准化的账户、签名、交易接口，避免业务方重复自建。 二、钱包核心服务 1.负责钱包核心后端服务的设计与开发，覆盖资产管理、代币列表、交易历史、上链广播、Gas 策略等关键链路。 2.负责大规模钱包数据（账户、资产、交易历史等亿级数据量）的存储设计、查询性能与版本兼容性。 3.负责钱包与中台基础能力（行情、Token、节点 RPC、资产）的集成与解耦，推动公共能力下沉、钱包业务上浮。 三、多链支持与上链 1.负责钱包多链支持的接入与维护，覆盖 EVM、Solana 及其他主流公链。 2.负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障在网络拥堵、Nonce 冲突等场景下的稳定性。 【任职要求】 一、技术基础 1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。 2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。 3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理；具备亿级数据量场景下的存储设计与查询优化经验。 4.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地，具备账户、订单、资产等核心域的建模经验。 5.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。 6.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。 7.熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网钱包或交易系统的实战经验。 8.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。 二、钱包专项 1.熟悉主流钱包账户体系，包括助记词 / 私钥 / 硬件钱包 / MPC / 托管钱包等的原理与差异，理解各类账户的安全模型与使用场景。 2.具备钱包后端的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过账户系统、资产模块、交易历史等核心模块的设计与落地。 3.具备多账户体系融合、抽象与对外开放能力建设的经验，或对此方向有清晰的方法论。 三、AI 工程能力 1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。 2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。 3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。 【加分项】 1.有 MPC / TSS 钱包后端的开发经验，或熟悉 Turnkey、Fireblocks、Privy 等托管钱包方案。 2.有 AA 智能合约钱包（EIP-4337 / EIP-7702、Safe、Biconomy 等）相关的开发经验。 3.有亿级数据量下的数据迁移、版本兼容、双写切换等实战经验。 4.有钱包安全相关经验（密钥管理、签名风控、欺诈检测等）。 5.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。 6.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

items.title: Technical Operations Analyst, User Safety & Risk
items.description: About the Team At OpenAI, our User Safety & Risk Operations (USRO) team helps protect our products and users from abuse, fraud, safety risks, and other forms of misuse. We operate at the front line of real-world safety and risk management, translating user and operational signals into timely decisions, effective interventions, and improvements to our systems. Within USRO, Risk Incubation & Systems builds the analytics, automation, monitoring, quality mechanisms, and operating systems that help teams identify risk, make sound decisions, and scale safely. Our work spans emerging-risk detection, operational measurement, workflow automation, quality systems, launch readiness, and decision-support tools. We partner closely with operational teams as well as Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Policy, Safety, Legal, and Support to identify high-leverage opportunities and build practical systems that improve outcomes. About the Role We are hiring a Technical Operations Analyst to solve ambiguous, high-impact operational problems using data, technical tools, and strong judgment. You will work as an experienced individual contributor across USRO, moving from problem definition through analysis, workflow design, implementation, measurement, and handoff. The scope is intentionally broad and may span emerging-risk detection, operational quality, automation, launch readiness, and other priority programs. You will be expected to move between different problem areas as organizational needs evolve. This is a hands-on role. You should be comfortable querying and validating data, building dashboards and lightweight automations, using AI tools to accelerate work, and working directly with operators and technical partners to turn incomplete information into practical systems. Your work may also include data and operational monitoring issues for major cloud deployment partnerships—for example, validating pipelines and safety signals, investigating anomalies or discrepancies, improving reporting and escalation mechanisms, and documenting data limitations so partner teams can act with confidence. Location / work model: London, UK; hybrid, 3 days/week in-office. Please note: This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning content. Strong discretion, judgment, and resilience are essential. In This Role, You Will - Independently scope ambiguous operational problems and frontier & emerging risks, and turn them into clear analyses, workflows, tools, or decision systems. - Analyze large and complex datasets to identify patterns, data-quality gaps, operational blind spots, and source-of-truth issues. - Build and maintain dashboards, monitoring, alerts, recurring reporting, and workflow automations. - Develop systems for detecting and assessing emerging risks, including classifier, evaluation, labeling, and human-review feedback loops. - Support major cloud deployments and partnerships by validating data pipelines and safety signals, investigating anomalies, and improving operational monitoring, reporting, and escalation. - Design practical quality controls such as sampling plans, golden datasets, validation holdouts, thresholds, human review, and fallback paths. - Use AI and LLM-based tools to improve speed and scale while applying appropriate testing, quality assurance, and human oversight. - Translate technical and operational findings into clear recommendations, tradeoffs, decisions, and next steps for partner teams. - Partner across Operations, Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Policy, Safety, Legal, and Support to define ownership, requirements, and durable handoffs. - Document system logic, limitations, operating procedures, and maintenance expectations so others can run and improve the work. You Might Thrive in This Role If You - Have 5+ years of experience in technical operations, data analytics, trust and safety, risk operations, product operations, or a related field. - Are strong in SQL and comfortable working with unfamiliar datasets, schemas, joins, denominators, and data-quality issues. - Have built practical dashboards, tools, automations, or operating systems and owned them from initial scoping through adoption and maintenance. - Can use AI and LLM tools to accelerate real workflows while independently validating outputs and managing failure modes. - Understand how to measure technical or operational systems using concepts such as precision, recall, coverage, error analysis, quality assurance, and human review. - Exercise sound judgment in scaled operations, including queues, escalations, reviewer workflows, capacity, quality, and incident response. - Move quickly in ambiguous environments, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and create structure without waiting for perfect requirements. - Communicate complex findings clearly to technical, operational, and leadership audiences and drive work through cross-functional partners. Nice to Have - Experience in trust and safety, fraud, scaled or adversarial abuse, integrity, emerging-risk detection, or other high-stakes operational domains. - Experience supporting cloud, enterprise, or privacy-preserving deployments with constrained data access or specialized monitoring requirements. - Experience with classifiers, evaluations, golden datasets, labeling programs, reviewer calibration, or model-quality measurement. - Experience with Python, notebooks, data-pipeline troubleshooting, or other lightweight technical development. - Experience designing quality systems or workflows that involve vendors, BPOs, or distributed operational teams. items.title: Staff PLM & Engineering Applications Engineer, Consumer Devices
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Consumer Devices team at OpenAI builds end-to-end hardware and software systems that bring AI into the physical world. We work at the intersection of custom silicon, embedded systems, operating systems, cloud services, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, and product design to deliver reliable, production-ready devices at scale. Within Consumer Devices, Hardware Engineering eXperience, or HEX, is a new bootstrapped team building the environments, applications, compute, product-data systems, and workflows that let hardware engineers do their work without needing to troubleshoot the machinery underneath. HEX owns virtual engineering environments, HPC/GPU compute, storage, networking, licensing, MCAD/ECAD/CAE applications, PLM, product data, automation, validation, and support as one connected system. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Staff PLM & Engineering Applications Engineer, you will be one of the first technical builders of HEX and the primary counterpart to the HEX lead. You will own the engineering-application and product-data side of the hardware engineering experience, with an initial focus on NX, Teamcenter, licensing, parts import, integrations, packaging, validation, and user workflows. This is not a traditional Teamcenter administration role and not a Corporate IT application-support role. You will take complex, fragile workflows and turn them into reliable engineering systems. This role is highly hands-on and systems-oriented. You will not inherit a mature environment and support queue. You will help build a fresh one, replacing manual setup guides, tribal knowledge, repeated support issues, and team handoffs with tested automation and reliable workflows. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Own the technical architecture, deployment, configuration, integration, validation, and long-term operation of NX and Teamcenter. - Build reliable workflows for parts import, product-data migration, metadata quality, BOMs, revisions, lifecycle states, and release processes. - Replace manual setup documentation with automated installation, configuration, validation, diagnostics, and recovery workflows. - Build tooling around NX, Teamcenter, MCAD, ECAD, CAE, plugins, licenses, and engineering environments. - Define and validate the golden path for hardware engineers: access, open, design, save, retrieve, release, simulate, and get help. - Partner with mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, simulation, manufacturing, systems, and product-design teams to understand where workflows break. - Work with Compute & Infrastructure-focused HEX Engineers so applications, product data, storage, VDI, HPC, and licenses feel like one coherent system. - Partner with contractors and vendors while keeping architecture, requirements, validation, acceptance, and long-term ownership inside HEX. - Build health checks, regression tests, observability, diagnostics, and support tooling that make failures easy to detect and recover from. - Help establish the technical standards, operating model, and engineering culture for the growing HEX organization. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Have deep hands-on experience with Teamcenter, NX, PLM systems, and CAD workflows in a hardware product-development environment. - Have owned PLM architecture, data models, integrations, migrations, parts imports, release workflows, and engineering application platforms. - Can write automation in Python, PowerShell, Bash, and similar tools. - Have experience with packaging, deployment, licensing, validation, and application integrations. - Understand parts, revisions, BOMs, configurations, lifecycle states, and change workflows. - Can debug across applications, infrastructure, licenses, VDI, networking, storage, compute, and product data. - Prefer building durable tooling and automation instead of managing ticket queues. - See a four-page setup guide and immediately want to replace it with a tested installer. - Are comfortable in a new bootstrapped team where the environment, standards, workflows, and operating model are still being built. - Can work directly with engineers, understand their pain, and turn repeated problems into reliable systems. items.title: Software Engineer, Manufacturing Infrastructure
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform. About the Role We're seeking a Software Engineer to join our First-Party Hardware team. In this role, you will design, build, integrate, and validate the software used to manufacture, qualify, and deliver our hardware from the factory. You will work across the stack to create the infrastructure that runs internally and externally to coordinate all aspects of the production process. You will create the critical tools and procedures to execute, capture, process, and present the data resulting from the end to end assembly and validation of our hardware across multiple vendors and sites. This role is hands-on and high-ownership. You will work closely across teams both internal and external to define the standards that will be used across our products to ensure the velocity and quality of our 1P hardware. You will own the implementation, deployment, and output of these systems as well their continued maintenance and SLAs. Location: San Francisco, CA (Hybrid: 3 days/week onsite). Relocation assistance available. In this role, you will: - Design, develop, and maintain the software infrastructure for manufacturing process execution and data export. - Own integration across internal customers and vendor systems and processes. - Build and maintain the CI, release, and delivery pipeline of tooling to external partners. - Build and maintain internal systems to ingest, process, deliver, and visualize critical data for internal teams and systems. - Build system health monitoring, telemetry, remote diagnostics, and recovery paths that make manufacturing failures traceable and actionable. - Develop automation frameworks and monitoring for board bring-up, rack bring-up, qualification, manufacturing readiness, deployment readiness, and long-term reliability. - Package engineering releases into manufacturing-ready software recipes: images, versions, logs, limits, remediation mapping, provisioning hooks, secure artifact handling, and traceable data export. - Debug complex production issues spanning hardware, firmware, kernel, services, networking, power, thermals, boot, provisioning, manufacturing, test, and cloud services. - Partner with hardware, firmware, security, networking, infrastructure, manufacturing, operations, and external engineering teams to define software contracts, unblock bring-up, and drive issues to closure. - Produce durable architecture notes, runbooks, validation records, and decision documents that help OpenAI and partner teams reproduce, operate, and improve the platform. You might thrive in this role if you have: - 7+ years of hands-on experience, or exceptional accomplishments demonstrating equivalent expertise, in system software, platform software, hardware diagnostics, and cloud infrastructure. - Strong programming skills in C, C++, Rust or similar systems languages, with experience building reliable software for real hardware. - Familiarity with scripting in languages such as shell and python as used in automation systems. - Familiarity with Linux-based hardware platforms, OpenBMC, Redfish, firmware update systems, kernel drivers, and fleet management software. - Demonstrated ability to debug live hardware using logs, packet captures, firmware traces, bus captures, lab hosts, BMC journals, Linux tooling, and carefully controlled experiments. - Experience with hardware bring-up, manufacturing or qualification testing, system diagnostics, release validation, or deployment of high-performance compute, accelerator, server, networking, storage, or embedded platforms. - Ability to reason across software, firmware, hardware, manufacturing, and operations boundaries, and to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, designs, tests, and decisions. - Proven track record working with external vendors, manufacturing partners, or partner engineering teams to define deliverables, review technical work, and drive issues to closure. - Familiarity with platform security topics such as secure boot, firmware signing, device provisioning, attestation, certificate handling, trusted update flows, or access-control design is a plus. To comply with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidates for this role may need to meet certain legal status requirements as provided in those laws and regulations. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. items.title: Quantitative Researcher
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is launching perpetual futures, and this role is the mathematical foundation the exchange runs on. You'll be the first dedicated quant on the perps product, working directly with the engineering team to build the pricing and risk infrastructure from the ground up. Your mandate covers the core mechanics of the exchange: how mark prices are constructed, how funding rates are designed and calibrated, and how margin parameters are set when new assets get listed. The liquidation engine, the funding settlements, the risk limits on every listed asset — all of it depends on the work you do in this role. This is a high-ownership, low-handoff role. You will move from research to specification to production code, and you will monitor what you build in live markets. We are looking for someone who finds that accountability motivating, not exhausting — someone who has been in that seat before and knows what it takes to get it right. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design and maintain the methodology for aggregating spot prices across multiple external venues, including outlier removal, source weighting, and staleness handling, so the mark price the liquidation engine depends on is always reliable - Build and calibrate the funding rate formula from first principles: premium calculation, interest rate components, clamping logic, and settlement cadence, tuned to keep perp prices anchored to spot across normal and stressed market conditions - Run the quantitative analysis for every new asset listing, determining initial margin, maintenance margin, leverage tiers, and max open interest based on historical volatility and liquidity data - Write formal, rigorous specifications for pricing methodologies and edge case handling that engineers can build directly from, with no ambiguity left to interpretation - Ship your own research into production, close the loop between modeling and implementation, and take direct ownership of continuously running systems - Monitor live model performance, investigate mark price anomalies and source divergences as they happen, and iterate on methodology when failure modes surface in real markets WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Quant experience at a perpetuals exchange or HFT firm, with direct, hands-on ownership of mark price construction, funding rate design, or margin modeling in production - Deep understanding of perp exchange mechanics — you can design and defend a complete funding rate formula, index aggregation methodology, and margin tier model from first principles, including how each breaks under adversarial or illiquid conditions - Strong market microstructure intuition: you understand how prices form across venues, how liquidity and staleness distort aggregated signals, and what happens to a multi-source index when sources disagree or go dark - The ability to implement your own research — you write rigorous specs and then build them in code; you do not hand off to engineers and walk away - Strong programming skills in Python; comfortable writing production-quality code, not just research notebooks - Rigorous thinking about edge cases: your models account for violent market moves, data outages, and source conflicts before they happen, not after - (Plus) Experience designing or working with multi-source price aggregation or oracle systems - (Plus) Background in execution or market making at a trading firm - (Plus) Familiarity with on-chain data sources and decentralized price feeds BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $250,000 to $350,000 annually, plus equity and benefits. This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? Between that, there are customer cases to untangle, external providers to work alongside and ways of working to improve as the business scales. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Melbourne office. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.title: Senior Growth Product Manager, AI-Native
items.description: About Magic Eden and Dicey Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets. We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up. The role Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own. This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer. What you'll do - Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up - Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it - Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work - Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them - Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does - Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of - Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting - Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable What we're looking for - Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required - Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist - AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further - High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first - Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others - Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it Backgrounds that tend to fit - Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company - MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them - Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report Why this is interesting - Competitive, top-of-market compensation - You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook - Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early - Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

You will contribute directly to our most impactful sportsbook initiatives, elevate our design quality, and help mentor team members by setting a high bar for product craft. The Mission As a key part of this role, you will be the lead designer for our new sports betting platform 🎲. This is a rare opportunity to re-envision how the traditional sports industry operates by building crypto-specific products to support these use cases. Think of this as a unique opportunity to completely rebuild the consumer stack using crypto. Many of these will be brand new experiences that will require a designer to push the boundaries of what is possible. Great candidates will be genuinely excited about sports, and a passion for sports betting is a significant plus. You'll bring a basic understanding of crypto and a proven track record of creating best-in-class consumer experiences. This is a unique opportunity to build and shape a design function while staying deeply connected to the craft. We operate completely AI-native, leveraging tools like Cursor and Claude Code to build, test, and ship high-fidelity functional prototypes at extreme velocity What You Bring - 6+ years of experience in product design, with a proven track record of operating at a senior level (e.g., Senior, Lead, or Principal) with experience mentoring other designers. - A basic understanding of crypto is required. Your portfolio should reflect a high degree of visual craft and strategic thinking. - A "builder" mindset, with a track record of operating with autonomy and thriving in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. - Proven ability to lead projects that simplify highly complex concepts into delightfully simple and intuitive user experiences. - Expert proficiency in Figma and other modern design and prototyping tools. - AI-First Tooling: Demonstrated experience or high comfort working with AI coding tools and LLM workflows to prototype interactive interfaces rapidly. - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions and build consensus from the team level to the executive level.

items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Developer Infrastructure org is the engine behind Robinhood's entire engineering organization — a collection of tightly integrated teams whose collective mission is to make every engineer at Robinhood faster, more reliable, and exponentially more productive. The org spans four major teams: DevX (Developer Experience), TestX (Test Infrastructure), Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform. DevX owns Robinhood's monorepo and Bazel-based build infrastructure — the critical layer between a developer writing code and that code being ready to ship — along with the company's full CI/CD pipeline and remote build execution cluster. TestX owns the infrastructure behind Robinhood's entire test experience: the integration test environments, and personal development environments that serve as miniature simulations of the full Robinhood system, giving engineers a safe, isolated space to test their code end-to-end before it ever touches production. Backend Platform and Mobile Platform own the core language runtimes, libraries, IDEs, and developer toolchains across Python, Go, TypeScript, Swift, and Android. Together, these teams share a single north star: leveraging AI and agentic systems to fundamentally transform Robinhood's software development lifecycle — making every engineer dramatically more productive and the entire org a force multiplier for the business. As the Senior Staff Software Engineer, Developer Infrastructure , you are the technical driver of this entire org — the Uber Tech Lead unifying DevX, TestX, Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform under one cohesive technical vision. Your primary focus will be DevX, owning the technical direction of Robinhood's most critical build and developer infrastructure. But your influence stretches far wider: you will be a driving force in weaving AI and agentic development deeply into every layer of the software development lifecycle — from intelligent code review and automated build pipelines to agentic coding systems that multiply what each engineer can ship. This is a rare opportunity to shape not just how Robinhood builds software today, but what engineering velocity looks like for the entire industry! This role is based in our New York City or Menlo Park office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. items.title: Workplace Lead
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Workplace Lead to own our physical space and what it feels like to work here. You'll report to the Head of People Experience and manage the Office Manager and Receptionist. On day one you're running NYC HQ — over the next year you'll build the team and systems to keep it running at 200 and 500 people, and lead a major office build-out. This is a strategic role, not an administrative one. You'll run the office like a product, constantly shipping improvements that make the space match the intensity of the work we do. You'll manage the team, the budget, and the vendors, and own how Polymarket's offices look and feel. Done well, the workplace becomes a reason people want to come in. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Keep NYC HQ running at a high bar every day: space, supplies, furniture, and vibes - Select and manage vendors (cleaning, catering, facilities maintenance) and own the workplace budget — plan it, track it, and find places to save - Make sure investors, candidates, and partners understand who Polymarket is the moment they walk in - Work with IT and Security on visitor management, room booking, inventory, and maintenance systems, and keep them working as we grow - Own workplace health and safety: routine checks, ergonomics, local compliance, and emergency preparedness including evacuation plans and drills - Work with Security on physical access and incident response, from building access to visitor protocols - Manage and grow the workplace team, starting with the Office Manager and Receptionists — set clear goals, coach the team, and hold a high bar - Write the playbooks and SOPs so the office runs well when you're not in the room - Own the in-office events program: happy hours, celebrations, and All Hands logistics - Partner with People on culture programming: swag, welcome kits, recognition, onboarding, and seasonal moments - Manage the landlord relationship and ensure the lease is honored, we're compliant with local ordinances, and we maintain a strong partnership with the building - Work with in-house designers and outside architects on timeline, permitting, furniture, and the move itself — delivering the new space on time, on budget, and with an exceptional experience for the team - Take on more sites and real estate as we grow, scoping and building out new space as Polymarket expands WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 7–10+ years in workplace, office operations, or facilities at a high-growth startup or tech company, including managing people - You've built a workplace function and led the team that runs it day to day - You've led a major office build-out or relocation - Sharp with budgets and vendors — you negotiate well and hold people accountable - You build durable systems instead of one-off fixes - Extreme ownership: when the AV dies mid-all-hands, you fix it and make sure it doesn't happen again - High taste and attention to detail — the office should look good and run well - A strong communicator who can talk to executives, engineers, and contractors and adjust to whoever's in the room - (Plus) Experience in fintech, crypto, or fast-moving startups - (Plus) Experience managing office build-outs in NYC specifically - (Plus) Event planning background, internal or external - (Plus) Familiarity with Notion, Slack, and modern workplace tools - (Plus) Experience partnering directly with People Ops/HR on culture programming BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $200,000 to $300,000 annually, plus equity and benefits. This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

items.description: About the Team The Finance Platform & Technology team builds and scales the systems and data architecture that power OpenAI’s core financial operations.
